diagnostics.message: sources a param from the claim type "order-placed", which is not a member of the registry claim-type vocabulary. Two vocabularies exist and they are not interchangeable (SDD §K, "map, do not equate"): registry claim TYPES are the planner's UPPER_SNAKE selection enum and are the only things that carry a validated VALUE, while the lowercase-hyphen success claim CLASSES are the responder's guard ids and have no value to read. A param naming the wrong vocabulary does not fail loudly at run time — it resolves by map lookup, misses, and leaves the param UNRESOLVED forever, so the workflow silently never runs.
